item.title: Travis Scott Sued for Alleged Drunken Assault on Miami Yacht Crew in 2024
item.description:
[Intro music plays, followed by the host's voice]
Host: "Welcome back to 'Trending Now'! Today, we're talking about a lawsuit against rapper Travis Scott. The incident in question happened two years ago on a chartered yacht in Miami. Let's dive in."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to the lawsuit, Travis Scott rented a 105-foot yacht called Carpe Diem to cruise around Miami's coast with three female guests. However, things took a turn when Scott allegedly became intoxicated and aggressive as the evening wore on."
[Short pause]
Host: "The boat's captain, Adrian Frometa, claims Scott pushed him from behind, struck him with a closed fist, and repeatedly threatened him. When Frometa called in his bosses, Mirnesa Hasanovic and John Steve Holguin, for backup, a further scuffle ensued. Holguin says he was knocked to the ground, and Hasanovic and Holguin had to barricade themselves inside the boat's interior to escape Scott's aggression."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Law enforcement arrived on the scene and arrested Scott for disorderly intoxication and trespassing. Although no criminal charges were pressed, Frometa, Hasanovic, and Holguin are now pursuing civil assault claims against the rapper. They allege they suffered both physical and emotional injuries from the incident and are seeking unspecified financial damages."
[Short pause]
Host: "A rep for Travis Scott declined to comment on the lawsuit. We'll be keeping an eye on this story as it develops. That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to 'Trending Now'!"
[Outro music plays]
